translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus me Mwaaen Kkewe Pwiin
Mwirin minneei nge Jesus a no fetaen rhag noan Galilee; ese tipaeni pwe epwe noa fetaen noan Judea pwe igiwe soamwooniir Jews ra mwerhaen repwe niiy noa.
Oaton Gupwunon Penaes a arapeto,
iwe mwaaen kkewe pwiin Jesus ra aengaeni pwe, “Wone nigiti igeei pwe wopwene noa Judea, pwe rhooakka rhoaniuwoamw repwe weri minikka wa feeori.
Aeremas rese oapa minikka repwe feeori igine re tipaeni pwe repwe pwae noa, nge iga wa feoffeeori minikkeei, pwaeri ngaeni faeinaengiy pwe repwe giuneog!” (
Mwaaen kkewe mwo pwiin nge rese niugiuniug ngaeni.)
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Esaaen oato mwamwaaiun pwe ipwe noa. Aaemi ese tiwegin eew oat nge efin ngaenigaemi.
Faeinaengiy ese mmwen epwe oapwutaegaemi, nge ngaang e oapwutaeyaei, pwe iga ngaang i aengaeni rhag pwe minikka feoffeeoriiur iga e aenneew.
Oawnoa aaemi oawpwe noa tapweei gupwun na. Ngaang isoapw noa tapweei gupwun na pwe esaaen itto mwo minna oatoi.”
E aengaeniir minneei iwe a notiw noan Galilee.
Jesus a Noa Tapweei Gupwunon Penaes we
Mwirin aar mwaaen kkewe pwiin noa tapweei gupwun we iwe nge Jesus a pwan noa; ese pwaeri noa aan noa, pwe eyopo noa rhag.
Rhooa kkewe soamwooniir Jews ra giutta fetaeneei rhag me faaen gupwun we. Ra aeiineow pwe, “Ifa iiy wonowe?”
Ra igin towunap rhooan mwangiuniungiun me noan pwuwa we. Aaemweoi ra iura pwe, “Erhai aeremas gacch.” Nge aekkaaemweoi re iura pwe, “Aapw, pwe e oatupwutupw aeremas.”
Aeremas rese fioangei fetaeneei pwe re mesagiiur soamwooniir Jews.
A nugunupan noa aan epwene moann gupwun we nge Jesus a noa noan Temple we iwe a noa rhaepiy tae aan fenai.
Rhooa kkewe soamwooniir Jews ra igin riutae ra iura pwe, “E ifa wusun nge mwaaeneei nge e giuneei minikkeei nge esooar aan suguun?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Minikka i fenaiuw nge saapw aaei fenai pwe e itto me reen Deus, iwe efangeto ngaang.
Iyo na e mwerhaen epwe feeori minna tipaen Deus nge epwe giuneei pwe aere minikka i fenaiuw nge e itto me reen Deus, ngaere ngaang iya aepesa wow mwaeniaei wooan oanongaei.
Iyo kka iir re aepesa wow mwaenieer wooan oanongeer nge iir re giutta rhag ssoaron iteer. Nge iyo na e mwerhaen giutta ssoaron iyo na efangeto iiy ina e wenewen, esooar eew min oatupwutupw reen.
Moses e ngaennegaemi anniug we, ngaere? Nge esooar erhai me neeimi ne e tapweei. Nge meeta oawwa mwerhaen pwe oawpwe niaei noa reen?”
Nge pwuwa we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Eyor mwuniaan woamw. Iyo na e mwerhaen epwe niug noa?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ifeeori eew kkeman nge oanongaemi nge oawwa maegin riutae reen.
Moses a akkiuneogaemi pwe oawpwe circumcise aegini naimi aetemwaaen (nge iwe saapw Moses pwe rhooawe rhaepetomi miniwe rerhaepiy tae), iwe oawwa circumcise aegini erhai aetemwaaen wooan Sabbath.
Ngaere re circumcise aegini erhai aetemwaaen wooan Sabbath pwe minni ete fereei anniug we aaen Moses, nge meeta oawwa soong wooai iga i aecchipwatae erhai aeremas wooan Sabbath reen?
Oawsoapw apwiung aeremas reen meeta na oawweri, pwe oawpwe apwiung reen minna e wenewen.”
Iiy Minne Kristus?
Aaemweoi re Jerusalem ra iura pwe, “Saapw ieen mwaaen we soamwoon kkewe re mwerhaen repwe niiy noa?
Pipiiy! A kkepas neeiir rhooanap, nge esooar meeta minne re iura reen! Meeta, re giuneei pwe iiy Kristus?
Nge aere Kristus enoa itto, esooar erhai ne epwe giuneei aere iiy aeremesaen iya. Nge oanongarh nge si giuneei iya iga mwaaen een e itto me ee.”

Iwe Jesus a feffenai noan Temple we, a kkepas temoag tae nge a iura pwe, “Oaw oanongonniuwaen giuneaei me iga i itto me ee? Saapw ngaang minne tipaei pwe ipwe itto. Nge iiy iyo na efangeto ngaang ina e wenewen. Aaemi oawse giuneei,
nge ngaang i giuneei, pwe iga itto me reen nge iiy efangeto ngaang.”
Iwe rhooawe ra menaen repwe torofi, nge esooar mane e anngaeni, pwe igiwe esaaen gona mwo oaton.
Nge towunepeer rhooawe re niugiuniug ngaeni me noan pwuwa we ra iura pwe, “Oatona epwe itto Kristus, epwe ssow kkeman kka epwe feeori me mmwaen mwaaen een?”
Poos ra Noa Repwe Torofi Jesus
Pharisees reno noan pwuwa we ra rongorong aar aeremas ngiuniungiuniuw kkepesaen Jesus, iwe iir me soamwooniir patere kkewe ra fangenoa aaemweoi poos repwe noa torofi.
Jesus a iura pwe, “Ipwene no egius rhag reemi, nge iya noa reen iyo we efangeto ngaang.
Oawpwe giuttayaei nge oawsoapw rhuungiaei, pwe aaemi oawsoapw mmwenen noa iga ipwe noa ee.”

Rhooa kkewe soamwooniir Jews ra aeiineo fengaen wooar, “Iya iga epwe noa ee nge sisoapw mmwenen weri? Epwene noa wooan eew aepinoamwon Greece igiwe aeremas kkewe naiurh reno ee, iwe a noa fenaiuw ngaeniir re Greeks?
Nge e iura pwe sipwe noa giutta nge sisoapw rhuungi, nge sisoapw mmwenen noa iga epwe no ee. Meeta faan minna e iura?”
Rhan we Efang Menaw
Oarosan raaenin gupwun we e igin yor ipitan, Jesus a iutae nge a kkepas temoag tae, “Iyo ne a moar epwe itto reei,
iwe nge iyo ne e niugiuniug ngaeniaei epwe iun. Pwe iwe Pwapwior we e Santus e iura pwe, ‘Rhan we efang menaw epwe pwuutiw me wenepeigin.’ ”
Jesus e kkepesaen mmwenen Espritu, pwe aeremas kka ra niugiuniug ngaeni nge repwene pwigi. Noan oatonaan nge Espritu esaaen fang mwo pwe iga Jesus esaaen toonong mwo noan minna nningen.
Aeiyaegin Nee Finaen Aeremas
Aaemweoi aeremas kkewe noan pwuwa we re rongorong aan aepesa miniwe nge ra iura pwe, “Mwaaeneei nge oanongaen pwe iiy Profeta we!”
Aaemweoi re iura pwe, “Iiy minne Kristus!” Nge aaemweoi re iura pwe, “Kristus esoapw itto me Galilee!
Pwapwior we e Santus nge e iura pwe, ‘Kristus nge teoteeon king David nge epwe supw me Bethlehem, aepinoamw we David eno ee.’ ”
Iwe a yor aeiyaegin nee finaen aeremas me reen pwuwa we pwonno faan ngaeni iiy Jesus.
Aaemweoi ra mwerhaen torofi, nge esooar mane emmwenen angetae paiun wooan.
Soamwooniir Jews Kkewe Rese Niugiuniug
Igiwe renoa sefaaen poos kkewe, soamwooniir patere kkewe me Pharisees ra aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta oawse pwigito reen?”
Poos kkewe ra iura pwe, “Esaaen yor erhai ne eweei aaen kkepas mwaaen een!”
Pharisees kkewe ra aeiineeor pwe, “Aaemi mwo nge epwan oatupwugaemi?
A yor mwo erhai soamwoon kaan aere Pharisees pwe re niugiuniug ngaeni?
Pwuwa eei nge ese giuneei anniug kkewe aaen Moses, iwe iir ra no faaen aaen Deus aegaeregaer!”
Erhai Pharisee itan Nicodemus, mwaaen we a fasiun noa mwo reen Jesus. A aengaeniir pwe,
“Noan aarh Anniug nge sisoapw mmwenen oamonofiti erhai iga sisaaen apwiungiiur mwo pwe sipwe giutta meeta na efeeori.”
Ra iura pwe, “Iwe, nge een erhai rhooan Galilee? Aeraegi Pwapwior we e Santus pwe wopwe giuneei pwe esooar profeta e ikkitto me Galilee.” [
Iwe erhai nge enoa reen imwan.
